text_block_list.text:
At last, enough members have gathered to 
form a team and participate in the Aoharu 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Aoharu Cup, training levels 
increase according to your team rank. You 
want to rack up as many wins as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, we need to decide on a team name. 
There are the suggestions we received 
earlier, and then there's Team <Carrots>, which I 
came up with myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding on "HOP CHEERS" as the team name, 
it was filled into the race entry form and 
submitted.
